annotations.title: Can a shopper make this retailer an offer?

description: Returns whether a shopper can make this retailer an offer instead of paying the listed price. answer is yes (the retailer accepts offers through Bidit now; offers_url is where) or not_yet (the retailer does not; register_interest_url and consent_text describe how a shopper can register the price they would pay). There is no third state.
